        row_inputs = ("request_state_rows", "row_slot_ids", "row_generations", "live_rows")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.mtp and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for capacity in reversed(batch_sizes):
                name = f"resume{capacity}" + suffix
                forward = PreparedResume(mode_weights, requests, pool, inputs, completion, frame, sequence,
                    rows=capacity, runtime=None, vocabulary_runtime=None, coordinator=coordinator,
                    session=session, name=name, activation_mode="auto", buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                add(name, forward, "resume", capacity, 1, (*row_inputs, "sampling_grammar_mask"), enabled)
                for mode in ("init", "restore", "snapshot"):
                    name = f"{mode}{capacity}" + suffix
                    forward = PreparedMaintenance(mode, requests, pool, commands, inputs, completion, frame, sequence,
                        runtime=None, coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name, capacity=capacity,
                        admission_buffers=admission, draft_state=enabled, buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                    fields = row_inputs if mode == "snapshot" else ("request_state_rows", *admission.__dataclass_fields__)
                    add(name, forward, mode, capacity, 1,
                        (*fields, "page_tables", *commands.buffers()), enabled)
    with phase(progress, "Prepare and tune kernels") as stage, transient:
        tuning = session.tune(show_progress=progress is not None, console=stage.console)
    stream, graph_pool = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device), package_storage.graph_pool.id

    assets = {role: {"path": str(snapshot / file)}

    assets["chat_template"] = annotated_template_asset(
        (snapshot / "chat_template.jinja").read_bytes(), Path(__file__).parents[1] / "qwen38" / "assets" / "chat_template.patch.json")
    eos = weights.config.text["eos_token_id"]
    tokenizer = json.loads((snapshot / "tokenizer_config.json").read_text())
    eos_text = tokenizer["eos_token"]
    if isinstance(eos_text, dict):
        eos_text = eos_text["content"]
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
    tokenizer_eos = Tokenizer.from_file(str(snapshot / "tokenizer.json")).token_to_id(eos_text)
    eos_ids = list(dict.fromkeys([*(eos if isinstance(eos, list) else [eos]), tokenizer_eos]))
    server_config = dict(identity=identity, model_id=snapshot.name, max_sequence_tokens=config.context,
        prefill_chunk_size=config.prefill_chunk_size, pages=pages, state_rows=state_rows, snapshots=snapshots,
        page_tokens=PAGE_TOKENS, frontend=prepare_frontend(snapshot, eos_token_ids=eos_ids),
        sampling_defaults=RECIPE.sampling_defaults.as_dict(), assets=assets,
        model_contract=prepare_contract(signatures, buffers, pool, vocabulary=vocabulary))
    if config.mtp:
        server_config.update(speculative_widths=config.speculative_widths,
            speculative_fixed_width=config.speculative_fixed_width,
            speculative_token_capacity=speculative_token_capacity(
                config.max_active, max(config.speculative_widths), config.speculative_token_capacity))
    if config.benchmark_selection is not None:
        pages = max(pages, config.benchmark_selection.physical_pages(PAGE_TOKENS))
        package_storage.grow("KV_PAGES", pages)
        pool.memory_capacity[1] = pages
        pool.clear_for_preparation()
        server_config["pages"] = pages
        torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
    free, total = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)
    memory = dict(rank=0, world_size=1, device=config.device, weights_bytes=weights.allocated_bytes,
        mapped_host_bytes=0, offloaded_bytes=0, continuation_bytes=pool.backing.nbytes, state_rows=state_rows,
        preparation_state_rows=int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()),
        preparation_state_bytes=int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()) * layout.row_bytes,
        pages=pages, page_bytes=page_bytes(weights.config, mtp=config.mtp), page_tokens=PAGE_TOKENS,
        kv_bytes=pages * page_bytes(weights.config, mtp=config.mtp), completion_output_bytes=completion.nbytes, operator_scratch_bytes=arena.nbytes, graphs=len(graphs),
        prefill_capacities=prefill_sizes, free_device_bytes=free, total_device_bytes=total,
        headroom_bytes=config.headroom_bytes, tuning=tuning, compiled_decoder=config.compile_decoder,
        speculative_shapes=shapes, speculative_round_shapes=config.speculative_round_shapes,
        speculative_graph_budget=config.speculative_graph_budget, draft_buffer_bytes=draft_buffers.nbytes,
        target_buffer_bytes=target_buffers.nbytes, context_buffer_bytes=context_buffers.nbytes, graph_buffer_bytes=graph_buffers.nbytes, private_buffer_bytes=private_buffers.nbytes)
    if scoring is not None:
        memory.update(scoring.memory_report())
    state = None
    if config.benchmark_selection is not None:
        state = {name: tensor for name, tensor in buffers.items() if name != "state_pool"}
        state["state_pool"] = pool.backing[:int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item())]
        state.update((f"cache.{name}", tensor[:pages]) for name, tensor in pool.pages.items())
        state.update((f"request.{field.name}", getattr(requests, field.name)) for field in dataclass_fields(requests))
        state.update((f"speculation.rng.{field.name}", getattr(speculation.rng, field.name))
                     for field in dataclass_fields(speculation.rng))
        state.update({"speculation.generation": speculation.generation, "speculation.offset": speculation.offset})
    roots, components = _declared_weight_roots(weights)
    prepared = PreparedModel(rebuild_weights=declare_weights(roots, components=components, layers=()), device=config.device, graphs=graphs, buffers=buffers, signatures=signatures,
        max_active=config.max_active, session=session, server_config=server_config, memory_report=memory,
        benchmark_state=state, benchmark_pool=pool if state is not None else None,
        benchmark_requests=requests if state is not None else None,
        benchmark_rounds=None if state is None else {name: forward for name, forward in forwards.items()
            if signatures[name].kind == "speculative"},
        close_resources=(() if scoring is None else (scoring,)),
        export_zero_ranges=(*(() if scoring is None else scoring.zero_ranges()),
                           *storage_ranges([prefill_storage, decode_storage, arena.tensor, metadata,
                                            graph_buffers.chunks, private_buffers.chunks, target_buffers.chunks, context_buffers.chunks, draft_buffers.chunks,
                                            () if speculation is None else (speculation.draft_scratch.scratch_tensors(), speculation.records),
                                            [f.scratch_tensors() for f in forwards.values() if hasattr(f, "scratch_tensors")]]), *completion.zero_ranges()),
        resources=(scoring, weights, pool, requests, inputs, admission, commands, arena, forwards, prefill_storage,
                   decode_storage, metadata, compiled, stream, graph_pool, session, coordinator,
                   graph_buffers, private_buffers, target_buffers, context_buffers, draft_buffers, speculation))

    return prepared

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PreparationConfig:
    collective_tuning: str = "static"
    collective_ladder: dict | None = None
    prompt_logprobs: bool = False
    compile_workers: int | None = None
    native_dense_activations: bool = False
    lock_gpu_clocks: bool = False
    autotune_effort: str = "default"
    tuning_replica: TuningReplica | None = None
    devices: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(8))
    context: int = 262144
    prefill_chunk_size: int = 4096
    max_active: int = 4
    snapshot_budget_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    headroom_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    compile_decoder: bool = True
    retain_graphs: bool = False
    kernel_cache: Path | None = None
    stream_overlap: bool = True
    dflash: bool = False
    draft_snapshot: Path | None = None
    speculative_widths: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(1, 9))
    speculative_fixed_width: int | None = None
    speculative_token_capacity: int | None = None
    speculative_graph_budget: int = 64

    def __post_init__(self):
        if len(self.devices) != 8 or len(set(self.devices)) != 8 or any(d < 0 for d in self.devices):
            raise ValueError("Muse Spark preparation requires eight distinct GPUs")
        request_capacity(self.max_active)
        if not PAGE_TOKENS <= self.context <= 262144 or self.context % PAGE_TOKENS:
            raise ValueError("Muse Spark context must be 128-aligned in [128,262144]")
        if not 64 <= self.prefill_chunk_size <= self.context or self.prefill_chunk_size % 64:
            raise ValueError("Muse Spark prefill chunk must be 64-aligned and fit the context")
        if self.snapshot_budget_bytes <= 0 or self.headroom_bytes < 0:
            raise ValueError("snapshot budget must be positive and headroom nonnegative")
        if self.dflash and self.draft_snapshot is None:
            raise ValueError("Muse Spark DFlash requires a resolved draft checkpoint")
        _ = self.speculative_round_shapes

    @property
    def speculative_round_shapes(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import parallel_speculative_shapes

        return parallel_speculative_shapes(self.max_active, self.speculative_widths,
            self.speculative_token_capacity, self.speculative_graph_budget,
            fixed_width=self.speculative_fixed_width) if self.dflash else ()

    @property
    def decode_tokens(self):
        return max((packed for _, _, packed in self.speculative_round_shapes),
                   default=request_capacity(self.max_active))

    @property
    def decode_samples(self):
        return max((batch * width for batch, width, _ in self.speculative_round_shapes),
                   default=request_capacity(self.max_active))


@torch.no_grad()
@with_autotune_effort
def prepare_rank(snapshot, config, *, rank, group, progress=None, package_storage):
    from .recipe import RECIPE

    snapshot = Path(snapshot).resolve()
    shard = TensorParallelShard(rank, len(config.devices))
    device = torch.device("cuda", config.devices[rank])
    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
    with phase(progress, "Inspect checkpoint"):
        manifest = inspect_indexed_checkpoint(snapshot)
        headers = [s.header_sha256 for s in manifest.shards]
        draft_headers = ([s.header_sha256 for s in inspect_indexed_checkpoint(config.draft_snapshot).shards]
                         if config.dflash else [])
    weights = ModelWeights.load(manifest, device, shard=shard, progress=progress,
        package_storage=package_storage, draft_snapshot=config.draft_snapshot if config.dflash else None)
    del manifest
    release_unused()
    transient = contextlib.ExitStack()
    transient.enter_context(package_storage.transient())
    layout = continuation_layout(weights.config, shard, dflash=config.dflash)
    snapshots = layout.snapshot_capacity(config.snapshot_budget_bytes)
    if snapshots < 1:
        raise ValueError("snapshot budget must hold one complete Muse Spark continuation")
    slots, blocks = request_capacity(config.max_active), config.context // PAGE_TOKENS
    draft_rows = slots * weights.config.draft.block_size if config.dflash else 0
    tokens = max(config.prefill_chunk_size, config.decode_tokens, draft_rows)
    state_rows, pages = slots + snapshots, (config.prefill_chunk_size + PAGE_TOKENS - 1) // PAGE_TOKENS + 2 * slots
    total_memory = minimum_across_ranks(torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)[1], group)
    with phase(progress, "Allocate model state"):
        pool = ContinuationPool.allocate(weights.config, shard, state_rows + 1, pages, device,
            storage=package_storage, maximum_pages=total_memory // page_bytes(weights.config, shard),
            maximum_rows=total_memory // layout.row_bytes, backed_slots=min(state_rows + 1, 1 + 2 * slots),
            dflash=config.dflash)
        vocabulary = weights.config.vocabulary
        requests = DeviceRequestState.allocate(device, vocab_size=vocabulary, capacity=slots)
        inputs = BatchInputs.allocate(tokens, blocks, device, capacity=slots)
        admission = AdmissionBuffers.allocate(device, vocab_size=vocabulary, capacity=slots)
        commands = StateCommands.allocate(device, capacity=slots)
        frame = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        sequence = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        completion = CompletionOutputs.allocate((2, slots, 24), device=device)
        coordinator = CollectivePreparation(group)
        # Reduce each routed expert output before the replicated mixture finalizer.
        expert_width = weights.config.text["moe_hidden_size"]
        routed_width = weights.config.text["num_experts_per_tok"] * expert_width
        collective = create_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, collective_tuning=config.collective_tuning,
            max_tokens=max(config.decode_tokens, draft_rows), hidden_size=routed_width,
            ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        prefill_collective = create_dma_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=tokens,
            hidden_size=routed_width, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        vocabulary_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device,
            max_rows=max(config.decode_samples, draft_rows),
            columns=weights.config.vocabulary_partition(shard)[2] * shard.world_size,
            ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        embedding_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=min(tokens, 128),
            columns=weights.config.hidden, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        preexpert_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=min(tokens, 128),
            columns=expert_width, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        identity = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(dict(config=weights.config.text, headers=headers,
            draft=None if weights.config.draft is None else weights.config.draft.text,
            draft_headers=draft_headers, kv_dtype="float8_e4m3fn",
            world_size=shard.world_size, contract="muse-spark.text.v1"), sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        session = RecordedPreparationSession(compile_workers=config.compile_workers,
            collective_tuning=config.collective_tuning, collective_ladder=config.collective_ladder, autotune_effort=config.autotune_effort,
            tuning_replica=config.tuning_replica, native_dense_activations=config.native_dense_activations,
            lock_gpu_clocks=config.lock_gpu_clocks, device=device, checkpoint=identity,
            workload_schema="muse_spark", numerical_policy="default", coordinator=coordinator,
            headroom_bytes=config.headroom_bytes, benchmark_storage=package_storage)
        session.__enter__()
        arena = ScratchArena(device, overlap=config.stream_overlap)
        session.register_scratch(arena)
        graph_buffers, private_buffers = (GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20) for _ in range(2))
        target_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20) if config.dflash else None
        context_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20) if config.dflash else None
        with package_storage.scratch_pool() as scratch_pool:
            prefill_storage = Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, config.prefill_chunk_size, 1, device,
                                               buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
            decode_storage = Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, config.decode_tokens, config.decode_samples, device,
                                              buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
        buffers = dict(inputs.buffers(), **commands.buffers(),
            **{name: getattr(admission, name) for name in admission.__dataclass_fields__},
            state_pool=pool.backing, memory_capacity=pool.memory_capacity, request_pending_token=[REDACTED],
            sampling_grammar_mask=requests.grammar_mask, frame_index=frame, submission_sequence=sequence,
            **completion.buffers())
        speculation = None
        if config.dflash:
            from .dflash import SpeculativePreparation

            speculation = SpeculativePreparation(weights, pool, requests, inputs, decode_storage,
                completion=completion, frame=frame, sequence=sequence, session=session, workspace=arena,
                runtime=collective, vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective,
                context_runtime=embedding_collective, embedding_runtime=embedding_collective,
                preexpert_runtime=preexpert_collective, coordinator=coordinator,
                buffers=graph_buffers.cursor(), decoder_buffers=target_buffers.cursor(),
                context_buffers=context_buffers.cursor())
    scoring = PromptScoring.allocate(config, device, buffers, frame=frame, group=group,
        ipc=package_storage.peer_storage, runtime=collective, coordinator=coordinator)
    forwards, signatures, metadata = {}, {}, {}
    prefills, batches = prefill_capacities(config.prefill_chunk_size), batch_capacities(config.max_active)
    with phase(progress, "Construct graph catalog"):
        def add(name, forward, kind, rows, tokens, fields, *, enabled=None, packed_tokens=0):
            if kind == "scored_prefill":
                forward = PreparedScoredPrefill(forward, requests, inputs)
                fields = (*fields, "prompt_target_tokens")
            forwards[name] = forward
            signatures[name] = GraphSignature(kind, rows, tokens, tuple(fields), speculation_enabled=enabled,
                                              packed_token_capacity=packed_tokens)

        forward_inputs = (*inputs.buffers(), "sampling_grammar_mask")
        modes = (True, False) if config.dflash else (False,)
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.dflash and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for kind, mode, sizes in prefill_modes(prefills, () if enabled else reversed(batches), scoring):
                for capacity in sizes:
                    rows = 1 if mode == "prefill" else capacity
                    name = f"{kind}{capacity}" + (suffix if mode == "prefill" else "")
                    private = private_buffers.cursor()
                    m = metadata[name] = Metadata.allocate(capacity, rows, blocks, device, buffers=private)
                    scratch = (prefill_storage if mode == "prefill" else decode_storage).rows(capacity, rows)
                    decoder = PreparedDecoder(mode_weights, scratch, m, pool, mode=mode,
                        runtime=prefill_collective if mode == "prefill" else collective,
                        embedding_runtime=embedding_collective, preexpert_runtime=preexpert_collective,
                        vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name, workspace=arena,
                        buffers=private, scoring=scoring if kind == "scored_prefill" else None)
                    batch = PreparedBatch(inputs, requests, m, mode=mode, shard=shard, pool=pool, buffers=private)
                    forward = PreparedGeneration(decoder, batch, completion, frame, sequence,
                        runtime=collective, coordinator=coordinator, session=session,
                        name=name + ".generation", workspace=arena, buffers=private,
                        context_factory=None if speculation is None else speculation.forwards.context)
                    add(name, forward, kind, rows, capacity if mode == "prefill" else 1, forward_inputs,
                        enabled=enabled)
        if speculation is not None:
            from ignition.components.parallel_draft import PreparedParallelDraftRound

            for batch, width, packed in sorted(config.speculative_round_shapes,
                    key=lambda shape: (shape[2], shape[0]), reverse=True):
                name = f"speculative{batch}x{width}-tokens{packed}"
                forward = PreparedParallelDraftRound(speculation, batch, width, name,
                    buffers=private_buffers.cursor(), target_token_capacity=packed)
                forward.prepare()
                add(name, forward, "speculative", batch, width, forward_inputs, enabled=True,
                    packed_tokens=packed)
        row_inputs = ("request_state_rows", "row_slot_ids", "row_generations", "live_rows")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.dflash and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for capacity in reversed(batches):
                name = f"resume{capacity}" + suffix
                forward = PreparedResume(mode_weights, requests, pool, inputs, completion, frame, sequence, rows=capacity,
                    runtime=collective, vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective, coordinator=coordinator,
                    session=session, name=name, buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                add(name, forward, "resume", capacity, 1, (*row_inputs, "sampling_grammar_mask"), enabled=enabled)
                for mode in ("init", "restore", "snapshot"):
                    name = f"{mode}{capacity}" + suffix
                    forward = PreparedMaintenance(mode, requests, pool, commands, inputs, completion, frame, sequence,
                        runtime=collective, coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name, capacity=capacity,
                        admission_buffers=admission, draft_state=enabled, buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                    fields = row_inputs if mode == "snapshot" else ("request_state_rows", *admission.__dataclass_fields__)
                    add(name, forward, mode, capacity, 1, (*fields, "page_tables", *commands.buffers()), enabled=enabled)
    with phase(progress, "Prepare and tune kernels") as stage, transient:
        tuning = session.tune(show_progress=progress is not None and rank == 0, console=stage.console)
    stream, graph_pool = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device), package_storage.graph_pool.id
    if config.compile_decoder:
        scratch_pool.release_backing()

    def materialize():
        scratch_pool.materialize()
        pool.clear_for_preparation()

    try:
        graphs, compiled = capture_forwards(forwards, signatures, session=session, device=device, stream=stream,
            pool=graph_pool, collective=collective, coordinator=coordinator, compile_decoder=config.compile_decoder,
            progress=progress, cache_root=config.kernel_cache, retain_graphs=config.retain_graphs,
            materialize=materialize, warmup_storage=package_storage,
            compile_kinds=("prefill", "scored_prefill", "decode", "resume", "speculative"))
    finally:
        scratch_pool.materialize()
    session.freeze()
    pool.clear_for_preparation()
    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
    release_unused()
    assets = runtime_assets(snapshot)
    frontend = prepare_frontend(snapshot, eos_token_ids=weights.config.text["eos_token_id"])
    server_config = dict(identity=identity, model_id=snapshot.name, max_sequence_tokens=config.context,
        prefill_chunk_size=config.prefill_chunk_size, pages=pages, state_rows=state_rows, snapshots=snapshots,
        page_tokens=PAGE_TOKENS, frontend=frontend, sampling_defaults=RECIPE.sampling_defaults.as_dict(), assets=assets,
        model_contract=prepare_contract(signatures, buffers, pool, vocabulary=vocabulary,
                                       draft_lag=0 if config.dflash else None))
    free, total = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)
    memory = dict(rank=rank, world_size=shard.world_size, device=config.devices[rank], weights_bytes=weights.allocated_bytes,
        mapped_host_bytes=0, offloaded_bytes=0, continuation_bytes=pool.backing.nbytes, state_rows=state_rows,
        preparation_state_rows=int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()),
        preparation_state_bytes=int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()) * layout.row_bytes,
        pages=pages, page_bytes=page_bytes(weights.config, shard), page_tokens=PAGE_TOKENS,
        kv_bytes=pages * page_bytes(weights.config, shard), kv_dtype="float8_e4m3fn", completion_output_bytes=completion.nbytes,
        operator_scratch_bytes=arena.nbytes, graphs=len(graphs), graph_buffer_bytes=graph_buffers.nbytes,
        private_buffer_bytes=private_buffers.nbytes, prefill_capacities=prefills, free_device_bytes=free,
        total_device_bytes=total, headroom_bytes=config.headroom_bytes, tuning=tuning, compiled_decoder=config.compile_decoder)
    if scoring is not None:
        memory.update(scoring.memory_report())
    if config.dflash:
        from ignition.components.capacity import speculative_token_capacity

        server_config.update(
            speculative_widths=tuple(sorted({width for _, width, _ in config.speculative_round_shapes})),
            speculative_token_capacity=speculative_token_capacity(config.max_active,
                max(config.speculative_widths), config.speculative_token_capacity),
            speculative_fixed_width=config.speculative_fixed_width)
        memory.update(speculative_round_shapes=config.speculative_round_shapes,
                      speculative_graph_budget=config.speculative_graph_budget)
    channels = (collective, prefill_collective, vocabulary_collective, embedding_collective, preexpert_collective)
    disposable = [prefill_storage, decode_storage, arena.tensor, metadata, graph_buffers.chunks, private_buffers.chunks]
    if speculation is not None:
        disposable.extend((speculation.draft_scratch.scratch_tensors(), target_buffers.chunks, context_buffers.chunks))
        memory.update(speculative_buffer_bytes=target_buffers.nbytes, context_buffer_bytes=context_buffers.nbytes)
    for forward in forwards.values():
        if isinstance(forward, PreparedScoredPrefill):
            forward = forward.forward
        if hasattr(forward, "scratch_tensors"):
            disposable.append(forward.scratch_tensors())
        if hasattr(forward, "completion") and hasattr(forward.completion, "scratch_tensors"):
            disposable.append(forward.completion.scratch_tensors)
        if hasattr(forward, "decoder"):
            disposable.append(forward.decoder.scratch_tensors())
    return PreparedModel(rebuild_weights=declare_weights(weights, components=('embedding', 'norm', 'head', 'draft')),
        device=config.devices[rank], graphs=graphs, buffers=buffers, signatures=signatures, max_active=config.max_active,
        session=session, server_config=server_config, memory_report=memory,
        export_zero_ranges=(*(() if scoring is None else scoring.zero_ranges()), *storage_ranges(disposable), *completion.zero_ranges()),
        resources=(scoring, weights, pool, requests, inputs, admission, commands, arena, forwards, prefill_storage,
            decode_storage, metadata, compiled, stream, graph_pool, session, coordinator, *channels,
            scratch_pool, graph_buffers, private_buffers, target_buffers, context_buffers, speculation),
        close_resources=tuple(c for c in (*channels, scoring) if c is not None))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PreparationConfig:
    collective_tuning: str = "static"
    collective_ladder: dict | None = None
    prompt_logprobs: bool = False
    image_concurrency: int | None = None
    compile_workers: int | None = None
    native_dense_activations: bool = False
    lock_gpu_clocks: bool = False
    autotune_effort: str = "default"
    tuning_replica: TuningReplica | None = None
    devices: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(8))
    context: int = 1048576
    prefill_chunk_size: int = 4096
    max_active: int = 4
    snapshot_budget_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    headroom_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    compile_decoder: bool = True
    retain_graphs: bool = False
    kernel_cache: Path | None = None
    dflash: bool = True
    speculative_widths: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(1, 9))
    speculative_fixed_width: int | None = None
    speculative_token_capacity: int | None = None
    speculative_graph_budget: int = 64

    def __post_init__(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import image_capacity

        object.__setattr__(self, "image_concurrency", image_capacity(self.max_active, self.image_concurrency))
        if (
            len(self.devices) not in (2, 4, 8)
            or len(set(self.devices)) != len(self.devices)
            or any(d < 0 for d in self.devices)
        ):
            raise ValueError("MiMo preparation requires distinct GPUs dividing its eight QKV checkpoint shards")
        if not PAGE_TOKENS <= self.context <= 1048576 or self.context % PAGE_TOKENS:
            raise ValueError("MiMo context must be 128-aligned in [128,1048576]")
        if not 64 <= self.prefill_chunk_size <= self.context or self.prefill_chunk_size % 64:
            raise ValueError("prefill chunk size must be 64-aligned in [64,context]")
        request_capacity(self.max_active)
        _ = self.speculative_round_shapes
        if not self.speculative_widths or max(self.speculative_widths) > 8:
            raise ValueError("MiMo DFlash verification supports at most seven drafts")
        if (
            self.speculative_fixed_width is not None
            and self.speculative_fixed_width not in self.speculative_widths
        ):
            raise ValueError("fixed verification width must belong to the prepared widths")
        if self.snapshot_budget_bytes <= 0 or self.headroom_bytes < 0:
            raise ValueError("snapshot budget must be positive and headroom nonnegative")

    @property
    def request_capacity(self):
        return request_capacity(self.max_active)

    @property
    def prefill_capacities(self):
        return prefill_capacities(self.prefill_chunk_size)

    @property
    def batch_capacities(self):
        return tuple(reversed(batch_capacities(self.max_active)))

    @property
    def speculative_round_shapes(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import parallel_speculative_shapes

        return parallel_speculative_shapes(self.max_active, self.speculative_widths,
            self.speculative_token_capacity, self.speculative_graph_budget,
            fixed_width=self.speculative_fixed_width) if self.dflash else ()

    @property
    def decode_tokens(self):
        return max((packed for _, _, packed in self.speculative_round_shapes), default=self.request_capacity)

    @property
    def decode_samples(self):
        return max((batch * width for batch, width, _ in self.speculative_round_shapes), default=self.request_capacity)

    @property
    def draft_tokens(self):
        return max(self.speculative_widths) - 1 if self.dflash else 0


@torch.no_grad()
@with_autotune_effort
def prepare_rank(snapshot, config, *, rank, group, progress=None, package_storage=None):
    if package_storage is None:
        raise ValueError("MiMo preparation requires package storage")
    snapshot = Path(snapshot).resolve()
    shard = TensorParallelShard(rank, len(config.devices))
    device = torch.device("cuda", config.devices[rank])
    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
    with phase(progress, "Inspect checkpoint"):
        manifest = inspect_indexed_checkpoint(snapshot)
    transient = contextlib.ExitStack()
    transient.enter_context(package_storage.transient())
    weights = ModelWeights.load(manifest, device, shard=shard, progress=progress, dflash=config.dflash)
    release_unused()
    sequence = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
    with phase(progress, "Allocate model state and collectives"):
        layout = continuation_layout(weights.config, shard, dflash=config.dflash)
        snapshots = layout.snapshot_capacity(config.snapshot_budget_bytes)
        if snapshots < 1:
            raise ValueError("snapshot budget must hold a complete MiMo continuation")
        slots, blocks = config.request_capacity, config.context // PAGE_TOKENS
        state_rows = snapshots + slots
        initial_pages = (config.prefill_chunk_size + PAGE_TOKENS - 1) // PAGE_TOKENS + 2 * slots
        bytes_per_page = page_bytes(weights.config, shard)
        total_memory = minimum_across_ranks(torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)[1], group)
        pool = ContinuationPool.allocate(
            weights.config,
            shard,
            state_rows + 1,
            initial_pages,
            device,
            storage=package_storage,
            maximum_pages=total_memory // bytes_per_page,
            maximum_rows=total_memory // layout.row_bytes,
            backed_slots=min(state_rows + 1, 1 + 2 * slots),
            dflash=config.dflash,
        )
        requests = DeviceRequestState.allocate(device, vocab_size=152576, capacity=slots)
        inputs = BatchInputs.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, blocks, device, capacity=slots)
        admission = AdmissionBuffers.allocate(device, vocab_size=152576, capacity=slots)
        commands = StateCommands.allocate(device, capacity=slots)
        frame = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        completion = CompletionOutputs.allocate((2, slots, 24), device=device)
        coordinator = CollectivePreparation(group)
        ipc = package_storage.peer_storage
        draft_rows = slots * weights.config.draft.block_size if config.dflash else 0
        tokens = max(config.prefill_chunk_size, config.decode_tokens, draft_rows)
        collective = create_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, collective_tuning=config.collective_tuning, max_tokens=tokens, hidden_size=6144, ipc=ipc)
        prefill_collective = create_dma_all_reduce_runtime(
            group, device, max_tokens=config.prefill_chunk_size, hidden_size=6144, ipc=ipc
        )
        vocabulary_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(
            group, device, max_rows=max(config.decode_samples, draft_rows), columns=152576, ipc=ipc
        )
        context_collective = (create_all_gather_runtime(group, device,
            max_rows=tokens, columns=6144, ipc=ipc) if config.dflash else None)
        vision_collective = create_dma_all_reduce_runtime(group, device,
            max_tokens=PATCH_CAPACITIES[-1] // 4, hidden_size=6144, ipc=ipc)
        identity = hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "config": json.loads((snapshot / "config.json").read_text()),
                    "draft": json.loads((snapshot / "dflash/config.json").read_text()),
                    "headers": [s.header_sha256 for s in manifest.shards],
                    "world_size": shard.world_size,
                    "contract": "mimo_v2.graph-inputs.v1",
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            ).encode()
        ).hexdigest()
        session = RecordedPreparationSession(
            compile_workers=config.compile_workers, collective_tuning=config.collective_tuning, collective_ladder=config.collective_ladder, autotune_effort=config.autotune_effort, tuning_replica=config.tuning_replica,
            native_dense_activations=config.native_dense_activations, lock_gpu_clocks=config.lock_gpu_clocks,
            device=device,
            checkpoint=identity,
            workload_schema="mimo_v2-vision",
            numerical_policy="default",
            coordinator=coordinator,
            headroom_bytes=config.headroom_bytes,
            benchmark_storage=package_storage,
        )
        session.__enter__()
        session.register_benchmark_resource("continuations", pool, restore=pool.clear_for_preparation)
        # The recipe declares no stream overlap: every branch runs on the main stream.
        arena = ScratchArena(device, overlap=False)
        session.register_scratch(arena)
        graph_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
        prefill_storage = Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, config.prefill_chunk_size, 1, device,
                                           buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
        decoder_storage = Scratch.allocate(
            weights.config, shard, config.decode_tokens, config.decode_samples, device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor()
        )
        vision_inputs = VisionInputs.allocate(device)
        vision_prefill = PrefillVisionInputs.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, device)
        vision_state = VisionState(inputs, vision_prefill, requests, image_slots=config.image_concurrency, image_token=[REDACTED]"image_token_id"],
                                   features=FEATURES, hidden=HIDDEN)
        vision_storage = {}
        environment = DecoderEnvironment.load(snapshot, vision_state)
        buffers = dict(
            inputs.buffers(),
            **vision_inputs.buffers(),
            **vision_prefill.buffers(),
            **commands.buffers(),
            **{name: getattr(admission, name) for name in admission.__dataclass_fields__},
            state_pool=pool.backing,
            memory_capacity=pool.memory_capacity,
            sampling_grammar_mask=requests.grammar_mask,
            frame_index=frame,
            submission_sequence=sequence,
            **completion.buffers(),
        )
        forwards, signatures, metadata, scratch = {}, {}, {}, {}
        speculation = None
        if config.dflash:
            speculation = SpeculativePreparation(
                weights,
                environment,
                pool,
                requests,
                inputs,
                decoder_storage,
                completion=completion,
                frame=frame,
                sequence=sequence,
                session=session,
                workspace=arena,
                runtime=collective,
                vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective,
                context_runtime=context_collective,
                coordinator=coordinator,
            )

    scoring = PromptScoring.allocate(config, device, buffers, frame=frame, group=group,
        ipc=package_storage.peer_storage, runtime=collective, coordinator=coordinator)
    del manifest
    modes = (True, False) if config.dflash else (False,)
    count = (
        len(modes) * (prefill_graph_count(config.prefill_capacities, scoring) + 4 * len(config.batch_capacities))
        + len(config.speculative_round_shapes)
        + len(config.batch_capacities)
        + len(PATCH_CAPACITIES)
    )
    with phase(progress, "Construct graph catalog", total=count) as stage:

        def add(name, forward, kind, rows, tokens, fields, *, enabled=None, packed_tokens=0):
            if kind == "scored_prefill":
                forward = PreparedScoredPrefill(forward, requests, inputs)
                fields = (*fields, "prompt_target_tokens")
            forwards[name] = forward
            signatures[name] = GraphSignature(kind, rows, tokens, tuple(fields), speculation_enabled=enabled,
                packed_token_capacity=packed_tokens)
            stage.update(advance=1)

        forward_inputs = (*inputs.buffers(), "sampling_grammar_mask")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.dflash and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for kind, mode, capacities in prefill_modes(
                    config.prefill_capacities, () if enabled else config.batch_capacities, scoring):
                for capacity in capacities:
                    rows = 1 if mode == "prefill" else capacity
                    name = f"{kind}{capacity}" + (suffix if mode == "prefill" else "")
                    metadata[name] = Metadata.allocate(capacity, rows, blocks, device)
                    storage = prefill_storage if mode == "prefill" else decoder_storage
                    scratch[name] = storage.rows(capacity, rows)
                    decoder = PreparedDecoder(
                        mode_weights,
                        environment,
                        scratch[name],
                        metadata[name],
                        pool,
                        mode=mode, scoring=scoring if kind == "scored_prefill" else None,
                        runtime=prefill_collective if mode == "prefill" and capacity >= 1024 else collective,
                        vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator,
                        session=session,
                        name=name,
                        workspace=arena,
                    )
                    batch = PreparedBatch(
                        inputs,
                        requests,
                        metadata[name],
                        mode=mode,
                        shard=shard,
                        pool=pool,
                        validate_prefill=vision_state.validate_prefill if mode == "prefill" else None,
                    )
                    forward = PreparedGeneration(
                        decoder,
                        batch,
                        completion,
                        frame,
                        sequence,
                        runtime=collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator,
                        session=session,
                        name=name + ".generation",
                        workspace=arena,
                        context_factory=None if speculation is None else speculation.forwards.context,
                    )
                    add(
                        name,
                        forward,
                        mode,
                        rows,
                        capacity if mode == "prefill" else 1,
                        (
                            (*forward_inputs, *vision_prefill.buffers())
                            if mode == "prefill"
                            else forward_inputs
                        ),
                        enabled=enabled,
                    )
        if speculation is not None:
            from ignition.components.parallel_draft import PreparedParallelDraftRound

            speculation.sampling_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
            for batch, width, packed in sorted(config.speculative_round_shapes, key=lambda shape: (shape[2], shape[0]), reverse=True):
                name = f"speculative{batch}x{width}-tokens{packed}"
                forward = PreparedParallelDraftRound(speculation, batch, width, name,
                                                     buffers=speculation.sampling_buffers.cursor(), target_token_capacity=packed)
                forward.prepare()
                add(name, forward, "speculative", batch, width, forward_inputs, enabled=True, packed_tokens=packed)
        for capacity in reversed(PATCH_CAPACITIES):
            name = f"vision{capacity}"
            cursor = graph_buffers.cursor()
            vision_storage[capacity] = VisionScratch.allocate(capacity, shard, device, buffers=cursor)
            encoder = PreparedVision(
                weights.vision,
                vision_storage[capacity],
                vision_inputs,
                runtime=vision_collective,
                coordinator=coordinator,
                session=session,
                workspace=arena,
                name=name,
                buffers=cursor,
            )
            forward = PreparedVisionGeneration(encoder, vision_state, completion, frame, sequence, buffers=cursor)
            add(name, forward, "vision", 1, capacity, (*vision_inputs.buffers(), "vision_feature_slot"))
        row_inputs = ("request_state_rows", "row_slot_ids", "row_generations", "live_rows")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.dflash and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for capacity in config.batch_capacities:
                name = f"resume{capacity}" + suffix
                forward = PreparedResume(
                    mode_weights,
                    requests,
                    pool,
                    inputs,
                    completion,
                    frame,
                    sequence,
                    rows=capacity,
                    runtime=collective,
                    vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective,
                    coordinator=coordinator,
                    session=session,
                    name=name,
                )
                add(
                    name,
                    forward,
                    "resume",
                    capacity,
                    1,
                    (*row_inputs, "sampling_grammar_mask"),
                    enabled=enabled,
                )
                for mode in ("init", "restore", "snapshot"):
                    name = f"{mode}{capacity}" + suffix
                    forward = PreparedMaintenance(
                        mode,
                        requests,
                        pool,
                        commands,
                        inputs,
                        completion,
                        frame,
                        sequence,
                        runtime=collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator,
                        session=session,
                        name=name,
                        capacity=capacity,
                        admission_buffers=admission,
                        draft_state=enabled,
                    )
                    fields = (
                        row_inputs
                        if mode == "snapshot"
                        else ("request_state_rows", *admission.__dataclass_fields__)
                    )
                    add(
                        name,
                        forward,
                        mode,
                        capacity,
                        1,
                        (*fields, "page_tables", *commands.buffers()),
                        enabled=enabled,
                    )
    if progress is not None:
        progress(
            f"before tuning: {torch.cuda.memory_allocated(device) >> 20} MiB allocated, "
            f"{torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)[0] >> 20} MiB free"
        )
    with phase(progress, "Prepare and tune kernels") as stage, transient:
        tuning = session.tune(show_progress=progress is not None and rank == 0, console=stage.console)
    stream, graph_pool = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device), package_storage.graph_pool.id
    pages = initial_pages

    def materialize_cache():
        pool.clear_for_preparation()

    graphs, compiled = capture_forwards(
        forwards,
        signatures,
        session=session,
        device=device,
        stream=stream,
        pool=graph_pool,
        collective=collective,
        coordinator=coordinator,
        compile_decoder=config.compile_decoder,
        progress=progress,
        cache_root=config.kernel_cache,
        retain_graphs=config.retain_graphs,
        materialize=materialize_cache,
        warmup_storage=package_storage,
        compile_kinds=("prefill", "scored_prefill", "decode", "resume", "speculative", "vision"),
    )
    session.freeze()
    pool.clear_for_preparation()
    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    release_unused()
    if group is not None:
        torch.distributed.barrier(group=group)
    free, total = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)
    assets = {
        role: {"path": str(path)}
        for role, path in (
            ("tokenizer", snapshot / "tokenizer.json"),
        )
    }
    assets["chat_template"] = annotated_template_asset(
        (snapshot / "chat_template.jinja").read_bytes(),
        Path(__file__).with_name("assets") / "chat_template.patch.json")
    cache_regions = [history_region(buffers, "cache." + name, tensor, contract_proto.PAGED_KEY_VALUE)
        for name, tensor in pool.pages.items()]
    buffers["request_pending_token"] = requests.pending_token
    server_config = {
        "identity": identity,
        "model_id": snapshot.name,
        "max_sequence_tokens": config.context,
        "prefill_chunk_size": config.prefill_chunk_size,
        "pages": pages,
        "state_rows": state_rows,
        "snapshots": snapshots,
        "page_tokens": PAGE_TOKENS,
        "frontend": prepare_frontend(snapshot,
            eos_token_ids=json.loads((snapshot / "generation_config.json").read_text())["eos_token_id"],
            image_profile="mimo"),
        "sampling_defaults": RECIPE.sampling_defaults.as_dict(),
        "assets": assets,
        "model_contract": prepare_contract(signatures, buffers, pool, image_slots=config.image_concurrency, page_tokens=PAGE_TOKENS, draft_lag=0 if config.dflash else None, regions=cache_regions),
    }
    memory = {
        "rank": rank,
        "world_size": shard.world_size,
        "device": config.devices[rank],
        "weights_bytes": weights.allocated_bytes,
        "mapped_host_bytes": 0,
        "offloaded_bytes": 0,
        "continuation_bytes": pool.backing.nbytes,
        "preparation_state_rows": int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()),
        "preparation_state_bytes": int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()) * layout.row_bytes,
        "state_rows": state_rows,
        "pages": pages,
        "page_bytes": bytes_per_page,
        "page_tokens": PAGE_TOKENS,
        "kv_bytes": pages * bytes_per_page,
        "completion_output_bytes": completion.nbytes, "operator_scratch_bytes": arena.nbytes,
        "graphs": len(graphs),
        "prefill_capacities": config.prefill_capacities,
        "free_device_bytes": free,
        "total_device_bytes": total,
        "headroom_bytes": config.headroom_bytes,
        "allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_allocated(device),
        "reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_reserved(device),
        "tuning": tuning,
        "compiled_decoder": config.compile_decoder,
    }
    if scoring is not None:
        memory.update(scoring.memory_report())
    if config.dflash:
        server_config.update(
            speculative_widths=tuple(sorted({width for _, width, _ in config.speculative_round_shapes})),
            speculative_token_capacity=speculative_token_capacity(config.max_active, max(config.speculative_widths), config.speculative_token_capacity),
            speculative_fixed_width=config.speculative_fixed_width,
        )
        memory.update(speculative_round_shapes=config.speculative_round_shapes,
                      speculative_graph_budget=config.speculative_graph_budget)
    disposable = [
        prefill_storage,
        decoder_storage,
        arena.tensor,
        metadata,
        vision_storage,
        vision_state.arena,
        graph_buffers.chunks,
    ]
    if speculation is not None:
        disposable.append(speculation.draft_scratch)
        disposable.append(speculation.sampling_buffers.chunks)
    for forward in forwards.values():
        if isinstance(forward, PreparedScoredPrefill):
            forward = forward.forward
        if hasattr(forward, "completion") and hasattr(forward.completion, "scratch_tensors"):
            disposable.append(forward.completion.scratch_tensors)
        if hasattr(forward, "decoder"):
            disposable.append(forward.decoder.scratch_tensors())
        if getattr(forward, "context", None) is not None:
            disposable.append(forward.context.scratch_tensors())
    return PreparedModel(rebuild_weights=declare_weights(weights, components=('embedding', 'norm', 'head', 'draft', 'vision')),
        device=config.devices[rank],
        graphs=graphs,
        buffers=buffers,
        signatures=signatures,
        max_active=config.max_active,
        session=session,
        server_config=server_config,
        memory_report=memory,
        export_zero_ranges=(*(() if scoring is None else scoring.zero_ranges()),
                           *storage_ranges(disposable), *completion.zero_ranges()),
        resources=(scoring,
            weights,
            vision_state,
            vision_inputs,
            vision_prefill,
            vision_storage,
            graph_buffers,
            pool,
            requests,
            inputs,
            admission,
            commands,
            arena,
            forwards,
            prefill_storage,
            decoder_storage,
            scratch,

    collective_tuning: str = "static"
    collective_ladder: dict | None = None
    prompt_logprobs: bool = False
    image_concurrency: int | None = None
    compile_workers: int | None = None
    native_dense_activations: bool = False
    lock_gpu_clocks: bool = False
    autotune_effort: str = "default"
    tuning_replica: TuningReplica | None = None
    devices: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(8))
    context: int = 1048576
    prefill_chunk_size: int = 4096
    max_active: int = 4
    snapshot_budget_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    headroom_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    compile_decoder: bool = True
    retain_graphs: bool = False

    mtp: bool = True

    speculative_fixed_width: int | None = None
    speculative_token_capacity: int | None = None
    stream_overlap: bool = True
    expert_scale_compression: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import image_capacity

        object.__setattr__(self, "image_concurrency", image_capacity(self.max_active, self.image_concurrency))
        if self.expert_scale_compression not in (None, "csf"):
            raise ValueError("Step-5 expert scale compression must be None or 'csf'")
        if len(self.devices) not in (4, 8, 16) or len(set(self.devices)) != len(self.devices) or any(d < 0 for d in self.devices):
            raise ValueError("Step-5 preparation requires four, eight, or sixteen distinct GPUs")
        request_capacity(self.max_active)
        if not PAGE_TOKENS <= self.context <= 1048576 or self.context % PAGE_TOKENS:
            raise ValueError("Step-5 context must be 128-aligned in [128,1048576]")
        if not 128 <= self.prefill_chunk_size <= self.context or self.prefill_chunk_size % 128:
            raise ValueError("Step-5 prefill chunk must be 128-aligned and fit the context")
        speculative_shapes(self.max_active, self.speculative_widths, self.speculative_token_capacity)
        if max(self.speculative_widths) > 4:
            raise ValueError("Step-5 MTP supports at most three draft tokens")
        if self.speculative_fixed_width is not None and self.speculative_fixed_width not in self.speculative_widths:
            raise ValueError("fixed verification width must belong to the prepared catalog")
        if self.snapshot_budget_bytes <= 0 or self.headroom_bytes < 0:
            raise ValueError("snapshot budget must be positive and headroom nonnegative")


    @property
    def speculative_shapes(self):
        return (speculative_shapes(self.max_active, self.speculative_widths, self.speculative_token_capacity)

@torch.no_grad()
@with_autotune_effort
def prepare_rank(snapshot, config, *, rank, group, progress=None, package_storage):
    from .recipe import RECIPE

    snapshot = Path(snapshot).resolve()
    shard = TensorParallelShard(rank, len(config.devices))
    device = torch.device("cuda", config.devices[rank])
    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
    with phase(progress, "Inspect checkpoint"):
        manifest = inspect_indexed_checkpoint(snapshot)
        headers = [s.header_sha256 for s in manifest.shards]
    weights = ModelWeights.load(manifest, device, shard=shard, progress=progress, mtp=config.mtp,
        expert_scale_compression=config.expert_scale_compression, package_storage=package_storage)
    del manifest
    release_unused()
    transient = contextlib.ExitStack()
    transient.enter_context(package_storage.transient())
    layout = continuation_layout(weights.config, shard, mtp=config.mtp)
    snapshots = layout.snapshot_capacity(config.snapshot_budget_bytes)
    if snapshots < 1:
        raise ValueError("snapshot budget must hold one complete Step-5 continuation")
    slots, blocks = request_capacity(config.max_active), config.context // PAGE_TOKENS
    shapes = config.speculative_shapes
    decode_tokens = max((b * w for b, w in shapes), default=slots)
    draft_tokens = max((b * (weights.config.text["num_nextn_predict_layers"] + w) for b, w in shapes), default=slots)
    tokens = max(config.prefill_chunk_size, decode_tokens)
    state_rows, pages = slots + snapshots, config.prefill_chunk_size // PAGE_TOKENS + 2 * slots
    total_memory = minimum_across_ranks(torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)[1], group)
    with phase(progress, "Allocate model state"):
        pool = ContinuationPool.for_model(weights.config, shard, state_rows + 1, pages, device, mtp=config.mtp,
            storage=package_storage, maximum_pages=total_memory // page_bytes(weights.config, shard),
            maximum_rows=total_memory // layout.row_bytes, backed_slots=min(state_rows + 1, 1 + 2 * slots))
        vocabulary = weights.config.vocabulary
        requests = DeviceRequestState.allocate(device, vocab_size=vocabulary, capacity=slots)
        inputs = BatchInputs.allocate(tokens, blocks, device, capacity=slots)
        admission = AdmissionBuffers.allocate(device, vocab_size=vocabulary, capacity=slots)
        commands = StateCommands.allocate(device, capacity=slots)
        frame = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        sequence = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        completion = CompletionOutputs.allocate((2, slots, 24), device=device)
        coordinator = CollectivePreparation(group)
        collective = create_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, collective_tuning=config.collective_tuning, max_tokens=max(decode_tokens, draft_tokens),
            hidden_size=weights.config.hidden, element_bytes=4, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        prefill_collective = create_dma_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=tokens,
            hidden_size=weights.config.hidden, element_bytes=4, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        vision_collective = create_dma_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=PATCH_CAPACITIES[-1],
            hidden_size=1536, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        vocabulary_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=decode_tokens,
            columns=weights.config.vocabulary_partition(shard)[2] * shard.world_size, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        embedding_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=tokens,
            columns=weights.config.hidden, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        identity = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({"config": weights.config.text, "vision": weights.config.vision,
            "quantization": weights.config.quantization, "headers": headers, "world_size": shard.world_size,
            "contract": "step5.graph-inputs.v1"}, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        session = RecordedPreparationSession(
            compile_workers=config.compile_workers, collective_tuning=config.collective_tuning, collective_ladder=config.collective_ladder, autotune_effort=config.autotune_effort, tuning_replica=config.tuning_replica,
            native_dense_activations=config.native_dense_activations, lock_gpu_clocks=config.lock_gpu_clocks,
            device=device, checkpoint=identity, workload_schema="step5",
            numerical_policy="default", coordinator=coordinator, headroom_bytes=config.headroom_bytes,
            benchmark_storage=package_storage)
        session.__enter__()
        register_benchmark_state(session, pool.reserved_backing, storage=pool.reserved_backing,
                                 restore=pool.clear_for_preparation)
        arena = ScratchArena(device, overlap=config.stream_overlap)
        session.register_scratch(arena)
        graph_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
        private_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
        with package_storage.scratch_pool() as scratch_pool:
            vision_inputs = VisionInputs.allocate(device)
            vision_storage = VisionScratch.allocate(PATCH_CAPACITIES[-1], shard, device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
            prefill_storage = Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, config.prefill_chunk_size, 1, config.context,
                                               device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
            decode_storage = Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, decode_tokens, decode_tokens, config.context,
                                              device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
            draft_storage = (Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, draft_tokens, draft_tokens, config.context,
                                             device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor()) if config.mtp else None)
        vision_prefill = PrefillVisionInputs.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, device)
        vision_state = VisionState(inputs, vision_prefill, requests, image_slots=config.image_concurrency, image_token=128001,
                                   features=FEATURES, hidden=weights.config.hidden // shard.world_size)
        buffers = dict(inputs.buffers(), **vision_inputs.buffers(), **vision_prefill.buffers(), **commands.buffers(),
            **{name: getattr(admission, name) for name in admission.__dataclass_fields__},
            state_pool=pool.backing, memory_capacity=pool.memory_capacity, request_pending_token=[REDACTED],
            sampling_grammar_mask=requests.grammar_mask, frame_index=frame, submission_sequence=sequence, **completion.buffers())
        collectives = {"runtime": collective, "embedding_runtime": embedding_collective,
                           "vocabulary_runtime": vocabulary_collective, "coordinator": coordinator}
        speculation = None
        if config.mtp:
            speculation = SimpleNamespace(weights=weights, pool=pool, inputs=inputs, requests=requests, scratch=decode_storage,
                draft_scratch=draft_storage,
                session=session, workspace=arena, collectives=collectives, overlap=config.stream_overlap,
                completion=completion, frame=frame, sequence=sequence, rng=SpeculativeRngState.allocate(device, capacity=slots),
                offset=torch.zeros(slots, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                generation=torch.zeros(slots, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                sampling_scratch=None)
    scoring = PromptScoring.allocate(config, device, buffers, frame=frame, group=group,
        ipc=package_storage.peer_storage, runtime=collective, coordinator=coordinator)
    forwards, signatures, metadata = {}, {}, {}
    prefills, batches = prefill_capacities(config.prefill_chunk_size), batch_capacities(config.max_active)
    modes = (True, False) if config.mtp else (False,)
    with phase(progress, "Construct graph catalog"):
        def add(name, forward, kind, rows, tokens, fields, enabled=None):
            if kind == "scored_prefill":
                forward = PreparedScoredPrefill(forward, requests, inputs)
                fields = (*fields, "prompt_target_tokens")
            forwards[name] = forward
            signatures[name] = GraphSignature(kind, rows, tokens, tuple(fields), speculation_enabled=enabled)

        forward_inputs = (*inputs.buffers(), "sampling_grammar_mask")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.mtp and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for kind, mode, sizes in prefill_modes(prefills, () if enabled else reversed(batches), scoring):
                for capacity in sizes:
                    rows = 1 if mode == "prefill" else capacity
                    name = f"{kind}{capacity}" + (suffix if mode == "prefill" else "")
                    private = private_buffers.cursor()
                    m = metadata[name] = Metadata.allocate(capacity, rows, blocks, device, buffers=private)
                    scratch = (prefill_storage if mode == "prefill" else decode_storage).rows(capacity, rows)
                    execution_collectives = dict(collectives, runtime=prefill_collective if mode == "prefill" else collective)
                    decoder = PreparedDecoder(mode_weights, scratch, m, pool, mode=mode,
                        scoring=scoring if kind == "scored_prefill" else None, vision=vision_state,
                        session=session, name=name, workspace=arena, overlap=config.stream_overlap, buffers=private, **execution_collectives)
                    batch = PreparedBatch(inputs, requests, m, mode=mode, shard=shard, pool=pool,
                        validate_prefill=vision_state.validate_prefill if mode == "prefill" else None, buffers=private)
                    context = partial(PreparedFeedback, scratch=scratch, vision=vision_state, buffers=private, **execution_collectives)
                    forward = PreparedGeneration(decoder, batch, completion, frame, sequence, runtime=collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name + ".generation", workspace=arena,
                        context_factory=context if enabled else None, buffers=private)
                    add(name, forward, kind, rows, capacity if mode == "prefill" else 1,
                        (*forward_inputs, *(vision_prefill.buffers() if mode == "prefill" else ())), enabled)
        if speculation is not None:
            for batch, width in shapes:
                name = f"speculative{batch}x{width}"
                forward = PreparedRound(speculation, batch, width, name, buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                forward.prepare()
                add(name, forward, "speculative", batch, width, forward_inputs, True)
        for capacity in reversed(PATCH_CAPACITIES):
            private = private_buffers.cursor()
            name = f"vision{capacity}"
            encoder = PreparedVision(weights.vision, vision_storage.rows(capacity), vision_inputs, runtime=vision_collective,
                coordinator=coordinator, session=session, workspace=arena, name=name, buffers=private)
            add(name, PreparedVisionGeneration(encoder, vision_state, completion, frame, sequence, buffers=private),
                "vision", 1, capacity, (*vision_inputs.buffers(), "vision_feature_slot"))
        row_inputs = ("request_state_rows", "row_slot_ids", "row_generations", "live_rows")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.mtp and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for capacity in reversed(batches):
                name = f"resume{capacity}" + suffix
                forward = PreparedResume(mode_weights, requests, pool, inputs, completion, frame, sequence, rows=capacity,
                    runtime=collective, vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective, coordinator=coordinator,
                    session=session, name=name, buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                add(name, forward, "resume", capacity, 1, (*row_inputs, "sampling_grammar_mask"), enabled)
                for mode in ("init", "restore", "snapshot"):
                    name = f"{mode}{capacity}" + suffix
                    forward = PreparedMaintenance(mode, requests, pool, commands, inputs, completion, frame, sequence,
                        runtime=collective, coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name, capacity=capacity,
                        admission_buffers=admission, draft_state=enabled, buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                    fields = row_inputs if mode == "snapshot" else ("request_state_rows", *admission.__dataclass_fields__)
                    add(name, forward, mode, capacity, 1, (*fields, "page_tables", *commands.buffers()), enabled)
    with phase(progress, "Prepare and tune kernels") as stage, transient:
        tuning = session.tune(show_progress=progress is not None and rank == 0, console=stage.console)
    stream, graph_pool = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device), package_storage.graph_pool.id
    if config.compile_decoder:
        scratch_pool.release_backing()

    def materialize():
        scratch_pool.materialize()
        vision_inputs.vision_slot.fill_(-1)
        pool.clear_for_preparation()

    vision_names = tuple(f"vision{capacity}" for capacity in reversed(PATCH_CAPACITIES))
    catalog = {name: forwards[name] for name in (*vision_names, *(name for name in forwards if name not in vision_names))}
    try:
        graphs, compiled = capture_forwards(catalog, signatures, session=session, device=device, stream=stream,
            pool=graph_pool, collective=collective, coordinator=coordinator, compile_decoder=config.compile_decoder,
            progress=progress, cache_root=config.kernel_cache, retain_graphs=config.retain_graphs, materialize=materialize,
            warmup_storage=package_storage, compile_kinds=("prefill", "scored_prefill", "decode", "resume", "speculative", "vision"))
    finally:
        scratch_pool.materialize()
    session.freeze()
    pool.clear_for_preparation()
    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
    release_unused()
    from .frontend import runtime_assets
    assets = runtime_assets(snapshot)
    frontend = prepare_frontend(snapshot, eos_token_ids=weights.config.text["eos_token_id"])
    frontend["image"] = {"step": {}}
    server_config = {"identity": identity, "model_id": snapshot.name, "max_sequence_tokens": config.context,
        "prefill_chunk_size": config.prefill_chunk_size, "pages": pages, "state_rows": state_rows, "snapshots": snapshots,
        "page_tokens": PAGE_TOKENS, "frontend": frontend, "sampling_defaults": RECIPE.sampling_defaults.as_dict(), "assets": assets,
        "model_contract": prepare_contract(signatures, buffers, pool, image_slots=config.image_concurrency, vocabulary=vocabulary, mtp=config.mtp)}
    if config.mtp:
        server_config.update(speculative_widths=config.speculative_widths,
            speculative_fixed_width=config.speculative_fixed_width,
            speculative_token_capacity=speculative_token_capacity(
                config.max_active, max(config.speculative_widths), config.speculative_token_capacity))
    free, total = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)
    memory = {"rank": rank, "world_size": shard.world_size, "device": config.devices[rank], "weights_bytes": weights.allocated_bytes,
        "expert_scale_compression": config.expert_scale_compression,
        "mapped_host_bytes": 0, "offloaded_bytes": 0, "continuation_bytes": pool.backing.nbytes, "state_rows": state_rows,
        "preparation_state_rows": int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()),
        "preparation_state_bytes": int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()) * layout.row_bytes,
        "pages": pages, "page_bytes": page_bytes(weights.config, shard), "page_tokens": PAGE_TOKENS,
        "kv_bytes": pages * page_bytes(weights.config, shard), "completion_output_bytes": completion.nbytes, "operator_scratch_bytes": arena.nbytes, "graphs": len(graphs),
        "graph_buffer_bytes": graph_buffers.nbytes, "private_buffer_bytes": private_buffers.nbytes,
        "kv_dtype": "float8_e4m3fn",
        "prefill_capacities": prefills, "free_device_bytes": free, "total_device_bytes": total,
        "headroom_bytes": config.headroom_bytes, "tuning": tuning, "compiled_decoder": config.compile_decoder,
        "speculative_shapes": shapes,
        "speculative_token_capacity": server_config.get("speculative_token_capacity", 0)}
    if scoring is not None:
        memory.update(scoring.memory_report())
    channels = (collective, prefill_collective, vision_collective, vocabulary_collective, embedding_collective)
    disposable = [prefill_storage, decode_storage, vision_storage, arena.tensor, metadata, vision_state.arena,
                  weights.scale_scratch, graph_buffers.chunks, private_buffers.chunks]
    if speculation is not None:
        disposable.append(speculation.sampling_scratch)
    for forward in forwards.values():
        if isinstance(forward, PreparedScoredPrefill):
            forward = forward.forward
        if hasattr(forward, "scratch_tensors"):
            disposable.append(forward.scratch_tensors())
        if hasattr(forward, "completion") and hasattr(forward.completion, "scratch_tensors"):
            disposable.append(forward.completion.scratch_tensors)
        if hasattr(forward, "decoder"):

        if getattr(forward, "context", None) is not None:
            disposable.append(forward.context.scratch_tensors())

            disposable.extend((forward.errors, forward.encoder.scratch_tensors()))
    return PreparedModel(rebuild_weights=declare_weights(weights, components=('embedding', 'norm', 'head', 'draft', 'vision')), device=config.devices[rank], graphs=graphs, buffers=buffers, signatures=signatures,
        max_active=config.max_active, session=session, server_config=server_config, memory_report=memory,
        export_zero_ranges=(*(() if scoring is None else scoring.zero_ranges()),
                           *storage_ranges(disposable), *completion.zero_ranges()),
        resources=(scoring, weights, pool, requests, inputs, admission, commands, arena, forwards, prefill_storage,
                   decode_storage, metadata, compiled, stream, graph_pool, session, coordinator, *channels,
                   vision_inputs, vision_prefill, vision_state, vision_storage, scratch_pool, graph_buffers, private_buffers, speculation),
        close_resources=(*channels, *((scoring,) if scoring is not None else ())))

    context: int = 1048576
    prefill_chunk_size: int = 4096
    max_active: int = 32
    snapshot_budget_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    headroom_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    compile_decoder: bool = True
    retain_graphs: bool = False
    kernel_cache: Path | None = None
    stream_overlap: bool = True
    expert_scale_compression: str | None = None
    dspark: bool = True
    vision: bool = True
    diagnostic_graphs: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
    diagnostic_support_graphs: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    diagnostic_cache_pages: int | None = None
    speculative_widths: tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
    speculative_fixed_width: int | None = None
    speculative_token_capacity: int | None = 128
    speculative_graph_budget: int = 64
    packed_verification: bool | None = None
    draft_prefix_selection: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self):
        object.__setattr__(self, "image_concurrency", image_capacity(self.max_active, self.image_concurrency))
        if (not isinstance(self.devices, tuple) or len(self.devices) != 4
                or self.hosts is not None and (not isinstance(self.hosts, tuple) or len(self.hosts) != 4)
                or len(set(zip(self.hosts or ("",) * 4, self.devices))) != 4
                or any(type(device) is not int or device < 0 for device in self.devices)):
            raise ValueError("MiniMax M3 preparation requires four distinct host/device placements")
        if self.roce_ring and self.hosts is None:
            raise ValueError("RoCE ring requires ranks on separate hosts")
        request_capacity(self.max_active)
        if not PAGE_TOKENS <= self.context <= 1048576 or self.context % PAGE_TOKENS:
            raise ValueError("MiniMax M3 context must be 128-aligned in [128,1048576]")
        if not 64 <= self.prefill_chunk_size <= self.context or self.prefill_chunk_size % 64:
            raise ValueError("MiniMax M3 prefill chunk must be 64-aligned and fit the context")
        if self.snapshot_budget_bytes <= 0 or self.headroom_bytes < 0:
            raise ValueError("snapshot budget must be positive and headroom nonnegative")
        if self.expert_scale_compression not in (None, "csf"):
            raise ValueError("MiniMax M3 expert scale compression must be None or 'csf'")
        drafting = self.dspark and max(self.speculative_widths, default=1) > 1
        packed = drafting and (self.diagnostic_graphs is None or self.packed_verification is True)
        if self.packed_verification is None:
            object.__setattr__(self, "packed_verification", packed)
        if self.draft_prefix_selection is None:
            object.__setattr__(self, "draft_prefix_selection", "gpu" if packed else "cpu")
        if type(self.packed_verification) is not bool or self.draft_prefix_selection not in ("cpu", "gpu"):
            raise ValueError("DSpark requires a boolean packed mode and cpu/gpu prefix selection")
        if packed and (not self.packed_verification or self.draft_prefix_selection != "gpu"
                       or self.speculative_fixed_width is not None):
            raise ValueError("MiniMax M3 DSpark requires adaptive packed GPU rounds")
        if not drafting and (self.packed_verification or self.draft_prefix_selection != "cpu"):
            raise ValueError("packed GPU speculation requires positive DSpark draft depth")
        if self.dspark:
            if not self.speculative_widths or not set(self.speculative_widths) <= set(range(1, 9)):
                raise ValueError("MiniMax M3 DSpark verifies one through eight target positions")
            if self.speculative_fixed_width is not None and self.speculative_fixed_width not in self.speculative_widths:
                raise ValueError("fixed verification width must belong to the captured catalog")
            _ = self.speculative_shapes, self.packed_speculative_shapes

    @property
    def speculative_shapes(self):
        widths = (1,) if self.packed_verification else self.speculative_widths
        return speculative_shapes(self.max_active, widths, self.speculative_token_capacity) if self.dspark else ()

    @property
    def packed_speculative_shapes(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import packed_speculative_shapes

        return packed_speculative_shapes(self.max_active, max(self.speculative_widths),
            self.speculative_token_capacity, self.speculative_graph_budget) if self.packed_verification else ()


def _verification_variants(shapes, selected):
    for batch, width in sorted(shapes, key=lambda shape: shape[0] * shape[1], reverse=True):
        kinds = ("speculative",)
        for kind in kinds:
            name = f"{kind}{batch}x{width}"
            if selected is None or name in selected:
                yield name, kind, batch, width


@torch.no_grad()
@with_autotune_effort
